name: Maricopa County Air Quality Department Proposed Project Baccara Permit Notice
known_limitations: The document is an official Maricopa County Air Quality Department notice mirrored on the project applicant's website after the dated notice aged off the County's current public-notice list. It records a proposal to issue Permit P0013417 and a completed public-comment window, not a final permit, EPA non-objection, construction authorization, emissions performance, or operating compliance.
jurisdiction: Maricopa County proposed air quality Permit P0013417, facility F053690
automation_notes: Recheck the County air-quality public-notice and permit-report rails for final Permit P0013417, EPA review or objection, petitions, later modifications, compliance testing, enforcement, and operating emissions. Preserve the distinction between a proposed permit and an issued permit.
notes: Phase 55C proposed-air-permit record. The notice says MCAQD processed Takanock Baccara LLC's application and proposed Permit P0013417 for a power plant whose pollutants are products of combustion. It records a March 4-April 8, 2026 public-comment period and an April 6 hearing.
